statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail remains in the low band while macro stress is extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below the WATCH threshold; the next major conditional checkpoints are the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster, the cash open and the multi-stage FOMC sequence.
headline: Tail remains low as Europe approaches with extreme macro stress and major U.S. event risk ahead
body: Fresh reporting shows a cautious but not cleanly one-way global risk tone: S&P 500 futures were slightly firmer, the U.S. 10-year yield was near 4.99% after briefly exceeding 5%, and Brent remained near $108 after easing. Direct live NQ retracement structure is not independently verified, so Tail stays low despite extreme Stress.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail ranged from 17% to 23%. WATCH appeared through several pre-open and U.S. session windows, while Stress remained 92-99%; Tail returned to the low band after the cash close and stayed there overnight.
outlookSummary: Conditional Tail stays low through the European morning, rises to WATCH around the 12:30 UTC U.S. data and cash open, and peaks at 24% around the 17:45-20:15 UTC FOMC danger window. A higher band requires observed persistent one-way structure, failed retracements or a credible delayed second leg.
